title: feat(plugin-grid): one display page size read from the spec, and a distinct fetch batch (objectui#9853)
body:
Fixes #9853
Clause-②: yes — the undeclared display page size changes on three surfaces (inline grid 10 → the spec default, grouped groups-per-page 10 → the spec default, paged list 100 → the spec default), as ruled. The PR waits as a draft for the director seat's contract review (`needs:contract-review` stays on both carriers).

Rulings executed: `5749197629` (C-prime, items 1 and 2) as amended by `5824040487` (batch #223 item 4: the display default is **50**, declared once in the protocol; structure B). The grid, list and kanban halves all land in this PR. The first line is `Part of`, not `Fixes`, for one reason only: one pre-existing pin reads red, because structure B's paged/unpaged split re-issues the list's fetch on a view switch when nothing is declared. That needs a ruling, and it is described under **Open question** below. Once it is ruled, nothing else of the card stays open here, and the seat can switch the first line to the closing keyword.

This head merges `origin/main` at `0ffc423b1` (a merge commit: no rebase, no force-push, no pushed commit rewritten). This session: `https://claude.ai/code/session_012UwY3ahMixEFkfTUxMVkYm`.

## What changed

**Structure B: "page size" means one page, and only where there is a pager.**

- **`@object-ui/plugin-grid`.** `ObjectGrid` falls back to `DEFAULT_DISPLAY_PAGE_SIZE` on every page it shows: the server-paged table, the table over inline `data`, the grouped view's page of groups, and a server-grouped group's own page of rows. `DEFAULT_DISPLAY_PAGE_SIZE` is `readSpecDisplayPageSize()`, which reads `PaginationConfigSchema.parse({}).pageSize` from `@objectstack/spec/ui`. There is no local number behind the read: if the spec stops declaring a positive default, the module throws at load. `DEFAULT_FETCH_BATCH_SIZE` (50, value kept) is the grid's fetch batch. It is read only when the grid buckets a fetched window in the browser (`bucketsFetchedWindow`), and never as a page size.
- **`@object-ui/plugin-list`.** `DEFAULT_LIST_PAGE_SIZE = 100` splits in two. `DEFAULT_LIST_DISPLAY_PAGE_SIZE` is the same spec read, and applies when `paginate` is true (the flat grid view, which `ListView` pages on the server). `DEFAULT_LIST_FETCH_BATCH_SIZE = 100` (value unchanged) is the `$top` of the one unpaged fetch for every other view: kanban, calendar, gallery, timeline and the rest, plus a grouped grid's window. `effectivePageSize` now resolves after `paginate` and passes `paginate ? DEFAULT_LIST_DISPLAY_PAGE_SIZE : DEFAULT_LIST_FETCH_BATCH_SIZE` as the fallback. A declared `pagination.pageSize` still sizes every view, as before. `describeRefusedPageSize` now names the fallback the view actually used.
- **`@object-ui/plugin-kanban`.** `DEFAULT_KANBAN_LIMIT` is renamed `DEFAULT_KANBAN_FETCH_BATCH_SIZE`, value 100 unchanged. The refused-`limit` diagnostic now reads "ObjectKanban fetch batch: … fell back to its default fetch batch (100)" instead of "row cap".
- Docs: `packages/plugin-grid/README.md` and `content/docs/plugins/plugin-grid.mdx` (the undeclared page size, including a group's page and the bucketed window), `packages/plugin-list/README.md` (new section "Page size and fetch batch"), and `content/docs/plugins/plugin-kanban.mdx` (the section is retitled "Fetch batch (object-driven boards)" and says the default does not follow the display page size). No fenced code block was added or changed: the diff over `*.md` / `*.mdx` outside `.changeset/` has 0 changed fence lines and 0 changed import lines, and every insertion sits after an even number of fences.
- Changeset `.changeset/9853-grid-display-page-size-from-spec.md` (this PR's own) is rewritten: `minor` for plugin-grid, plugin-list and plugin-kanban, with the per-surface table below, and hosts told to declare `pagination.pageSize` (or a board's `limit`) to keep an old count.

## Measured before and after (renderer, `@objectstack/spec` 17.5.0)

The installed spec is 17.5.0, and `PaginationConfigSchema.parse({}).pageSize` answers 50. This table comes from a one-time reverse run. A probe (not committed) mounted the real `ObjectGrid`, `ListView` and `ObjectKanban` against a paging data source that also answers the group header query. It read rows off the screen and `$top` off the wire. It ran at head `a2c3e5ba7`, and again with `ObjectGrid.tsx`, `ListView.tsx` and `ObjectKanban.tsx` swapped to `main`'s blobs (blob hashes equal to `0ffc423b1`'s; on-disk markers `DEFAULT_SERVER_WINDOW_SIZE` 2, `DEFAULT_DISPLAY_PAGE_SIZE` 0, `DEFAULT_LIST_PAGE_SIZE` 3, `export const DEFAULT_KANBAN_LIMIT` 1). The restore was proven by hash equality with `HEAD` and an empty `git diff HEAD`.

| surface, nothing declared | before (`main` `0ffc423b1`) | after |
|:--|--:|--:|
| `object-grid` fetching its own rows: rows per page / `$top` | 50 / 50 | 50 / 50 |
| `object-grid` over inline `data`: rows per page | 10 | **50** |
| grouped `object-grid`: groups per page | 10 | **50** |
| server-grouped `object-grid`: `$top` of each group's row page | 50 | 50 |
| `list-view`, grid view (paged): rows per page / `$top` | 100 / 100 | **50 / 50** |
| `list-view` kanban, gallery, calendar, timeline, grouped grid: `$top` | 100 | 100 |
| `object-kanban` with no `limit`: `$top` | 100 | 100 |

Premises from the dispatch, re-measured:

- The self-fetching grid is 50 → 50, the inline grid 10 → 50, and groups 10 → 50. **Holds.**
- The spec default is read, not hardcoded. **Holds**: the stubbed pins below move with the spec, and ablation 2 reddens them.
- "The grouped fetch batch `DEFAULT_FETCH_BATCH_SIZE` is 50 today" is **partly overtaken by `main`**. Since objectui#7189, a grouped grid that fetches its own rows groups on the server: `serverGroupedFetch` strips `$top`, and each group pages its rows by the display page size. Since objectui#10881, a data source with no `queryGroupHeaders` is refused, and no rows are fetched. The batch therefore has one reader left: a grid that buckets a window in the browser. The case that reaches it today is a grouping key the principal may not read, over a source that answers the header query. It is its own constant (50) and is not read from the spec. The pin "a window the grid groups in the browser FETCHES the batch" runs that exact path.
- **The list half.** Only the flat grid view pages on the server: `paginate` is `currentView === 'grid' && !(groupingConfig?.fields?.length)`. Every other kind issues one unpaged `$top`. The previous executor's cost reproduces: with nothing declared, a paged-to-unpaged switch re-issues the fetch (`[50, 100]` on grid → kanban). See **Open question**.

## Conflict resolution (merge of `origin/main` `0ffc423b1`)

`git merge-tree` reported content conflicts in the three files the dispatch named. Every hunk:

1. `ObjectGrid.tsx`, the loader effect's dependency list. Resolved as `main`'s list and comments (it adds `schemaDefaultFilters`, `invalidationNonce`, `serverGroupedFetch`, `groupingNeedsHeaderQuery`), with this branch's `fetchWindow` in place of `serverPageSize`, because the loader's `$top` / `$skip` read `fetchWindow`.
2. `ObjectGrid.tsx`, the "Is the grouping on screen page-scoped?" marker block. `main` retired it (objectui#10881). This branch had only renamed what it compared against (`groupingRowsLoaded >= fetchWindow`), so `main`'s deletion stands. Nothing else reads `groupingIsPartial` (grep: 0).
3. `packages/plugin-grid/README.md` and 4. `content/docs/plugins/plugin-grid.mdx`: this branch's undeclared-page-size paragraph, followed by `main`'s retitled "Grouping is server-side" heading.

There was also one **semantic** conflict that git merged cleanly. This branch's `groupedFetch = usableGroupingFields(schema.grouping?.fields).length > 0` assumed that every grouped self-fetch buckets a window, and `main`'s server grouping made that false. Resolved in `3445f3213`: the predicate became `bucketsFetchedWindow`, which is `!serverGroupedFetch && !groupingNeedsHeaderQuery` plus a grouping entry left after known masked keys are refused. It is counted the way the two server predicates count, so the first fetch does not flip from page size to batch when the object's types land. The docs paragraph was rewritten to match. Carried on the same file: the server pagination comment's `framework #2212` is qualified as `objectstack-ai/objectstack#2212` (carrier note on this PR).

## Census of the three constants

Instrument: `git grep -n` over the whole tree for each old and new name, re-run at head.

- `DEFAULT_SERVER_WINDOW_SIZE`, `DEFAULT_FLAT_PAGE_SIZE`, `DEFAULT_GROUPS_PER_PAGE`, `DEFAULT_LIST_PAGE_SIZE`: 0 hits.
- `DEFAULT_KANBAN_LIMIT`: every reader updated to `DEFAULT_KANBAN_FETCH_BATCH_SIZE`. That covers `ObjectKanban.tsx`, `plugin-kanban/src/index.tsx`, two plugin-kanban pins, the types docblock (`objectql.ts`) and the zod `limit` describe text (`objectql.zod.ts`), `app-shell` `block-config.ts` and three app-shell pins, and the types read-text pin `object-kanban-group-by-limit-7322.test.ts`. That pin reads `export const DEFAULT_KANBAN_FETCH_BATCH_SIZE = 100;` and `$top: resolveRowLimit(schema.limit, DEFAULT_KANBAN_FETCH_BATCH_SIZE)` off disk. The `block-config.test.ts` regex now reads the new name.
- Left on purpose, all historical prose:
  - two docblock sentences that describe the old spelling as history (`ObjectKanban.tsx` "Before that ruling it was named…"; the objectui#9925 note);
  - one "re-measured then" sentence in `plugin-kanban/src/index.tsx`;
  - one in the 7322 types pin's header;
  - three pending changesets of other cards (7322, 7772, 8307), which describe the tree they were written about.

## Pins

**One pin across every paged surface: `packages/app-shell/src/__tests__/displayPageSizeFromSpec-9853.test.tsx` (new).** It lives in app-shell because that package already depends on grid, list and board, so no new dependency edge is needed. It stands in a spec default the spec never shipped, and a probe records that the stand-in's factory ran and what the real default is. It then mounts the real components.

- ONE assertion over grid self-fetch rows and `$top`, grid inline rows, grouped groups per page, group-row `$top`, paged list rows and `$top`. Every value equals the default read from the spec at test time.
- A second row: the unpaged list view and the standalone board both send `$top` 100, and neither equals the page size.

No literal 50 appears in any assertion.

Per package:

- `ObjectGrid.displayPageSizeDefault-9853.test.tsx` (reworked for the merged tree, stubbed spec default). Rows: stand-in live; every page the grid shows; the bucketed window fetches the batch; the selector shows the size in force (the stand-in is not a fixed step); the declared control on every surface including the bucketed fetch; the refused control. Grouped rows now use a data source that answers the group header query.
- `ListView.pageSizeAndFetchBatch-9853.test.tsx` (new, real spec). Rows: paged grid `$top` and hand-off = the spec default; five unpaged views `$top` = 100; the declared control on a paged and an unpaged view; the switch cost `[default, 100]`; the refused value names the fallback number.
- Kanban pins keep `$top` 100 under the new name.

**Flipped, none deleted:**

- `groupedPagination.test.tsx`: the fixture is two pages plus ten of the spec default. The resize step is derived (a fixed step that is not the default and splits the fixture in two), and the one-page control declares `pageSize` equal to the group count.
- `ObjectGrid.pageSizeNonPositive-9853.test.tsx`: the inline fixture is the spec default plus ten rows, so `12.5` still discriminates at 50.

These were the reds on head `454232890` (CI shards 4/8 and 5/8, and locally before rework: 9 failed / 17 passed across the three grid files). The grouped rows failed because `main`'s objectui#10881 refuses a grouped grid over a data source with no `queryGroupHeaders`.

## Ablations (predicted before running; each through `ablation-replace.mjs`, restore proven by blob == HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`)

1. **Tie the list's unpaged fallback to the page size.** Anchor `paginate ? DEFAULT_LIST_DISPLAY_PAGE_SIZE : DEFAULT_LIST_FETCH_BATCH_SIZE,` became `DEFAULT_LIST_DISPLAY_PAGE_SIZE,` (anchor 1 → 0, blob moved).
   - Predicted: list pin 7 red / 3 green, app-shell pin 1 red / 2 green.
   - Observed: **8 failed / 5 passed** = the five unpaged rows, the switch-cost row, the refused-name row, and the app-shell fetch-batch row. As predicted.
2. **Hardcode the display number in place of the spec read** in both `ObjectGrid.tsx` (`const DEFAULT_DISPLAY_PAGE_SIZE = 50;`) and `ListView.tsx`. Both anchors went 1 → 0.
   - Predicted: stubbed grid pin 4 red / 2 green, stubbed app-shell pin 1 red / 2 green, while the unstubbed list pin and `groupedPagination` stay green (they cannot tell a hardcoded 50 from the spec's 50).
   - Observed: **5 failed / 21 passed**: the grid rows every-page, bucketed, selector and refused, plus the app-shell every-paged-surface row. All unstubbed rows green. As predicted. This is why the cross-surface pin stands in the default.
3. **Root cause of the one remaining red** (below). The `10512` file at head: 1 failed / 5 passed. With the fallback collapsed back to one number for every kind (`DEFAULT_LIST_FETCH_BATCH_SIZE`): 6 passed. The extra query is exactly the kind-dependent window.

## Open question (blocks landing; this seat does not decide it)

`ListView.datasetChartAppliedFilter-10512.test.tsx`, row "CONTROL (objectui#7394): with nothing held, the switch to the dataset chart re-issues no query", reads `expected 2 to be 1` at head (CI shard 3/8 on `a2c3e5ba7`, reproduced locally).

- The cause, proven by ablation 3: with no declared `pageSize`, the grid view's window is the display default (50) and the chart's is the fetch batch (100). A switch therefore changes `$top`, and the list issues a real, different query.
- It is not objectui#7394's defect, which was a byte-identical duplicate request.
- It is inherent to structure B: the two views need different windows.

The pin is untouched. The options, with their costs, are in the `os-dev-report` on the card.

## Acceptance notes (not carded)

- The display default follows the installed spec. `@object-ui/plugin-grid` declares `@objectstack/spec` `^17.4.0` and `@object-ui/plugin-list` `^17.0.0`. A host whose lockfile resolves an older spec gets that spec's default, on every surface alike. The floors are not raised here.
- The earlier pending changeset of this card, `.changeset/9853-grid-non-positive-page-size.md`, ends by saying the default question "is handed back on the issue". That was true of its PR, and it publishes in the same release as this one, which answers it. Left as history.
- A declared `pagination.pageSize` still caps unpaged list views and a bound board, as before. Ruling `5824040487` splits only the undeclared fallback, and this PR reads it that way.
- Carried from the previous body, still true: the page-size `useState` seeds are read only at mount. The grouped view's `$skip` is `(serverPage - 1) * fetchWindow`, which now matters only on the bucketed-window path.
- Commit `43d21e6b1` (a pushed commit of the previous executor) carries a model-named co-author trailer. It is left as is: pushed history is not rewritten. Every commit of this round carries the model-free pair.

## Round 2: ruling record `5909000462` (head `5a2d1e66a`)

The maintainer answered the **Open question** above with A: accept the one extra fetch. Ruling record `5909000462` on the card records the ruling verbatim. The first line of this body is now the closing keyword. The paragraph under it that explains `Part of`, and the **Open question** and **Gates** sections above, describe head `a2c3e5ba7` and are superseded by this section. They are left as written.

- **Merge.** `origin/main` at `574d82fdf`, merged as commit `118cdbe5a` (no rebase, no force-push, no pushed commit rewritten). Git reported **no conflict hunk**. Both sides touched five files (`ObjectGrid.tsx`, the plugin-grid `README.md` and `plugin-grid.mdx`, and types `objectql.ts` and `objectql.zod.ts`), and all five auto-merged. The one `ObjectGrid.tsx` change from `main` (objectui#11021: the search term on the group header query) reads neither the page size nor the fetch batch. The old-name census, re-run on the merged tree, is unchanged from round 1.
- **Flipped row** (commit `39994581a`), in `ListView.datasetChartAppliedFilter-10512.test.tsx`. It was "CONTROL (objectui#7394): with nothing held, the switch to the dataset chart re-issues no query". It is now "with nothing held and no pageSize declared, the switch to the dataset chart re-issues exactly one query, whose $top moves from the spec display default to the fetch batch".
  - The first query's `$top` is read against `PaginationConfigSchema.parse({}).pageSize`.
  - The one further query's `$top` is read against `DEFAULT_LIST_FETCH_BATCH_SIZE`. `ListView.tsx` now exports that constant as a module export; the package index does not re-export it. No literal 100 appears in the row.
  - The further query equals the one on screen with only `$top` changed, so nothing the chart withholds reached it.
  - A comment cites ruling record `5909000462` by id.
- **New control, same file:** "CONTROL (objectui#7394 §1): with nothing held and a pageSize declared, the switch to the dataset chart re-issues no query". With a declared 7, the first `$top` is 7 and no further query follows. objectui#7394's own §1 (`ListView.viewSwitchRefetch-7394.test.tsx`) pins the same for grid to kanban.
- **No other assertion in the file changed.** The diff removes three lines: the old row's title, one header bullet and one import line.
- **Changeset** (commit `5a2d1e66a`). The plugin-list bullet now says the switch issues one request, whose `$top` is the fetch batch. It also says that this qualifies the pending objectui#10512 note, which publishes in the same release and reads "a switch into a dataset chart with no user filter set issues no new request": that sentence now holds only when a page size is declared. The objectui#10512 changeset itself is not edited (`check-changeset-overwrite` green). `check:changeset-claims` cannot flag that note, because it names no file path.
- **Ablation.** Predicted before running: the flipped row goes red on its `$top` assertion, and the other six rows stay green.
  - Mutation: `ablation-replace.mjs` replaced `paginate ? DEFAULT_LIST_DISPLAY_PAGE_SIZE : DEFAULT_LIST_FETCH_BATCH_SIZE,` with `DEFAULT_LIST_DISPLAY_PAGE_SIZE,`. The anchor count went 1 → 0 and the blob moved `5789e6b50742` → `85a9025b2d66`.
  - Observed: `Tests 1 failed | 6 passed (7)`, with `AssertionError: expected [] to deeply equal [ 100 ]` at the `$top` wait. As predicted.
  - Restore: the blob equals `HEAD`'s and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
  - No build was involved: the test imports `../ListView` from source.
